# Saved environment for the uboot-env area (mkenvimage -r), written by stone
# at provision time into the eMMC's user area before the first partition
# (offsets: avocado-env-mmc.cfg). avocadoctl flips avocado_boot_slot with
# fw_setenv; the env lives on the eMMC whatever disk the OS boots from.
#
# boot-a/boot-b/rootfs-a/rootfs-b are GPT partitions 1-4. Both boot partitions
# carry the same extlinux/extlinux.conf, whose append says
# root=PARTUUID=${avocado_root_partuuid} (U-Boot expands it), so the slot picks
# the kernel partition and the root.
avocado_boot_slot=a

# Load addresses from U-Boot's default env (deployed as u-boot-initial-env):
# a saved environment replaces the default one whole, so sysboot and the
# extlinux loader find none of these unless they are here.
# ponytail: copied, not generated; diff against u-boot-initial-env on a U-Boot
# bump, or generate this file from it if it ever drifts.
baudrate=115200
bootdelay=2
fdt_high=0xffffffffffffffff
initrd_high=0xffffffffffffffff
scriptaddr=0x4c100000
pxefile_addr_r=0x4c200000
kernel_addr_r=0x48000000
kernel_comp_addr_r=0x50000000
kernel_comp_size=0x08000000
fdt_addr_r=0x4c000000
fdtoverlay_addr_r=0x4c0f0000
ramdisk_addr_r=0x4c800000
loadaddr=0x58000000
fdtfile=renesas/r9a09g056n48-hummingboard-iiot.dtb

# Boot counting for a freshly activated slot. avocadoctl's activate sets
# avocado_boot_tries=3 with the new slot and its commit clears it once the new
# OS verifies; a slot that never gets that far is abandoned here after three
# tries, before any userspace exists to roll it back.
avocado_bootcount=\
  if test -n "${avocado_boot_tries}"; then\
    if test "${avocado_boot_tries}" -le 0; then\
      echo "avocado: slot ${avocado_boot_slot} never committed, rolling back";\
      if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
        setenv avocado_boot_slot a;\
      else\
        setenv avocado_boot_slot b;\
      fi;\
      setenv avocado_boot_tries;\
    else\
      setexpr avocado_boot_tries ${avocado_boot_tries} - 1;\
    fi;\
    saveenv;\
  fi;\
  true;

avocado_boot_init=\
  if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
    echo "Booting B";\
    setenv bootpart 2;\
    setenv rootpart 4;\
  else\
    if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" != "a"; then\
      echo "avocado_boot_slot=${avocado_boot_slot} unset or invalid";\
      setenv avocado_boot_slot a;\
    fi;\
    echo "Booting A";\
    setenv bootpart 1;\
    setenv rootpart 3;\
  fi;

# The eMMC (mmc 0) in the selected slot. sysboot only returns on failure.
avocado_boot_emmc=\
  setenv devnum 0;\
  if part uuid mmc 0:${rootpart} avocado_root_partuuid; then\
    sysboot mmc 0:${bootpart} any ${scriptaddr} /extlinux/extlinux.conf;\
  fi;\
  true;

# The microSD (mmc 1): slot A only. A card is a provisioning or recovery
# medium here; OTA slots live on the eMMC, beside the environment.
avocado_boot_sd=\
  setenv devnum 1;\
  if part uuid mmc 1:3 avocado_root_partuuid; then\
    echo "avocado: booting the microSD";\
    sysboot mmc 1:1 any ${scriptaddr} /extlinux/extlinux.conf;\
  fi;\
  true;

# The boot chain follows the slot. Each boot partition carries the FIP (BL31 +
# U-Boot) its OS was built with, at /bootchain/fip.bin; before booting a slot,
# U-Boot compares it with the SPI NOR copy (offset 0x60000, where BL2 loads
# it) and rewrites SPI and resets when they differ. An OTA that ships a new
# FIP applies it on the first boot of the new slot, and a rollback puts the
# old slot's FIP back. BL2 (SPI offset 0) is not updated over the air: a
# failed BL2 write leaves the board for the SCIF download recovery (the
# serial provision profile). A failed FIP write is the same single-copy risk.
avocado_fip_offset=0x60000
avocado_fip_max=0x180000
avocado_bootchain=\
  if load mmc 0:${bootpart} ${loadaddr} /bootchain/fip.bin; then\
    setenv avocado_fip_size ${filesize};\
    if test 0x${avocado_fip_size} -gt ${avocado_fip_max}; then\
      echo "avocado: /bootchain/fip.bin is larger than the SPI FIP region, not applied";\
    elif sf probe; then\
      sf read ${kernel_addr_r} ${avocado_fip_offset} ${avocado_fip_size};\
      if cmp.b ${loadaddr} ${kernel_addr_r} ${avocado_fip_size}; then\
        true;\
      else\
        echo "avocado: updating the SPI boot chain (FIP) from slot ${avocado_boot_slot}";\
        if sf update ${loadaddr} ${avocado_fip_offset} ${avocado_fip_size}; then\
          reset;\
        fi;\
      fi;\
    fi;\
  fi;\
  true;

bootcmd=run avocado_bootcount avocado_boot_init avocado_bootchain avocado_boot_emmc avocado_boot_sd; fastboot usb 0
